transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is that... most nights, once my wife goes to bed, I end up in the kitchen. And I end up eating way past a normal plate of food. I'll get into things like fried chicken, mac and cheese, sweet potatoes, rolls... really whatever event leftovers are in there. I just keep going until a whole tray is empty, or like half the fridge is just gone.
During these episodes in the kitchen, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you are eating?

Yeah, that's exactly it. It's like... once I take that first bite, it feels like the decision has already been made for me. I'll even be standing there telling myself, 'George, stop now,' but it doesn't matter. My hands just keep fixing another plate, or opening another container. I just can't seem to stop it once it starts.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to get rid of the food or prevent weight gain, like making yourself throw up, using laxatives, or fasting?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or... anything like that. I don't really fast either. I just kind of sit there with it, feeling terrible about what I just did, and eventually I just go to sleep. But no, I don't try to get rid of the food.
How long have you been having these episodes of overeating?
It's been going on for a while now. I'd say... about a year and two months. It all kind of started right around the time the foreclosure process began on our house.
